overview: The Medford School Committee met to review the superintendent's annual goals, receive reports on district finances and enrollment, and approve a 2020 high school marching band trip to Hawaii.

items.title: School Committee Key Functions Draft Update
items.summary: Kathy Kreatz reported that the subcommittee met to develop key school committee functions and will present a revised draft at the December 17 meeting.

items.title: Superintendent's Report and Community Updates
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Edouard-Vincent provided updates on recent district achievements, winter athletic events, holiday charitable drives, and media coverage.

items.title: Report on Superintendent's Goals
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Edouard-Vincent outlined her four goals for the school year focused on entry strategy, instructional leadership, elementary mathematics achievement, and professional development; the report was accepted.

items.title: Report on MASC Conference
items.summary: Paulette Van der Kloot reported on sessions, speakers, and regional division updates from the annual joint MASC/MASS conference in Hyannis.

items.title: Commendation of Senior Festival Music Students
items.summary: Fine Arts Director Tony Szykniej and the committee commended students Arden Ingersoll and Christopher Walsh for being selected to the MMEA Northeast District Senior Festival.

items.title: Medford Mustang Marching Band Hawaii Trip Approval
items.summary: The committee approved a trip for the Mustang Marching Band to represent Massachusetts at the Pearl Harbor 75th Anniversary event in Hawaii in December 2020, with mandatory travel insurance included.

items.title: October 1 Student Enrollment Report
items.summary: Finance Director Kirsteen Patterson presented the finalized October 1 enrollment figures used for Chapter 70 state funding calculations.

items.title: FY18 Budget Closeout and Financial Report
items.summary: Finance Director Kirsteen Patterson reviewed the finalized FY18 closeout report detailing general fund appropriations, department savings, and revolving account balances; the report was accepted.

items.title: PTO Registration and 501(c)(3) Oversight Update
items.summary: The committee passed a motion requiring all affiliated PTOs and fundraising organizations to complete mandatory online registration by February 1, 2019.

items.title: Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: The committee observed a moment of silence for retired Medford teacher Mary Ann Cremins and former U.S. President George H.W. Bush.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee voted to enter executive session to discuss contract negotiations and legal matters.
